notes: Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct_tapi_wi4b128_p32c2048_vi8r4_g448.litertlm (the measured name; published 2026-11-01 in litert-community/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct-LiteRT under the name Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct_q4_ekv2048.litertlm): the bytes that name held before (sha256 6feca205…, upload commit 9ac47fea) with the vision encoder and adapter sections replaced by int8-weight copies of the same graphs (42,684,876,864 bytes vs 44,789,536,688). Measured in one A B B A + C window with the published bytes: arms A (the published file, vision on the GPU) vision 285.2 ms (283.5-292.2), first text 4.744 s, decode 8.55 tok/s, peak 46 GiB; arms B (this record) vision 276.4 ms, first text 4.740 s, peak 44 GiB = the registered speed line (vision more than 3 % faster, first text not slower) passed; arm C (this file, vision on the CPU) vision 561.4 ms, first text 5.020 s = a slower form, no record. Arms A re-measured bytes that have a 2026-10-31 record (qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct-int4, the run-3 window: decode 8.31 tok/s), so they are a sentence here, not a row. The published file's vision encoder section is 2,553,783,680 bytes, over the 2 GiB limit of LiteRT-LM 0.19.0's file-information call (refused there; the engine runs it, arms A); this file's is 653,432,240 and is accepted.
